title: Counselor Desk Reference: Add-On Size and the Patient Payment Plans Add-On Fee
content:
The desk applies an add-on size share to the add-on fee on a Patient Payment Plans plan, according to the add-on booked on the handling date.

**Rule.** The add-on size share of the fee is 0.60 when the add-on enrollment entry booked on the handling date is below 1,000.00 (1000.00), 0.80 when it is at least 1,000.00 but below 2,500.00 (2500.00), and 1 when it is 2,500.00 or more. The share multiplies the tier's setup fee within the scheduled add-on fee, acting on the tier's setup fee itself; the scheduled add-on fee is carried unrounded until the fee is entered.

**Record read.** The amount of the add-on enrollment entry booked on the plan on the handling date.

| Add-on booked on the handling date | Add-on size share |
|---|---|
| Below 1,000.00 | 0.60 |
| 1,000.00 or more, below 2,500.00 | 0.80 |
| 2,500.00 or more | 1 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical amounts).**

- 999.99: 0.60. 1,000.00: 0.80.
- 2,499.99: 0.80. 2,500.00: 1.

**Figure (hypothetical tier setup fee of 40.00, this share alone).** An add-on of 687.65 gives 0.60 and a scheduled add-on fee of 24.00.
